problem: Exact-main production rendered pricing with the i18n stylesheet marker present but without assets/js/i18n.js in the final HTML. The browser therefore had zero language selects and could not start the NL/EN roundtrip.
root_cause: tools/site-shell/apply-i18n.mjs treated any data-bg-i18n-asset marker as proof that all i18n assets were already installed. Pricing already contained the CSS marker, so the transform returned before injecting assets/js/i18n.js and before completing mobile-control injection. Without the runtime script, no active host (#v18MobileDrawer, generic shared mobile root, or legacy #bgkopMob) could mount a selector.
prevention: Detect i18n CSS and i18n runtime script independently; never use one shared marker as completeness proof.
Always run idempotent mobile-language-control injection after asset reconciliation.
Treat #v18MobileDrawer as a first-class active mobile host while preserving generic and legacy hosts.
Inspect final production HTML for both assets before diagnosing host-selection logic.
Require exact-main Netlify commit equality plus visible mobile NL->EN->NL browser roundtrip before LIVE_BEWEZEN.

evaluation.expected_invariant: every public built page that uses i18n has both stylesheet and runtime script present independently, and the active mobile navigation exposes exactly one usable locale selector
